note: The scout agent's new strategies (agents/scout_strategies.py). bots: which bots' agents test it (bot1-bot4 portfolios, bot5/bot6 scalping 1-15 minutes, bot7 economic releases); timeframes: what the source states; markets: fx, index, metal, energy, crypto, stock (empty = all of the bot's).

strategies.name: RV EMA20 cross over the 5m EMA200, 0.5% stop, 1:2, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m chart: long when price crosses above EMA20 and close > EMA200 of 5m closes (short mirror) / stop 0.5% from entry / target 2x stop (1%)

strategies.name: Alligator + Fractals breakout, fractal stop, 1:3
strategies.rules: M30/H1/H4: Alligator 13/8/5 (shift 8/5/3) awake up, price above it, close above last up-fractal that does not touch the Alligator (short mirror) / stop at last down-fractal / target 1:3

strategies.name: Pavan CPR: cross above top CPR, stop at pivot, long only
strategies.rules: 1m intraday: previous close below TC=(prevH+prevL)/2 and close above it, long only / stop at pivot (H+L+C)/3 / target 50 points (ours: 0.2% of price)

strategies.name: NFP straddle of the 4-hour pre-release range, target = range
strategies.rules: 5m: 30 min before NFP take 4h high/low, buy stop 5-10 pips above high, sell stop 5-10 pips below low (ours: 1 ATR) / stop = the opposite order / target = entry +/- the range

strategies.name: NFP V-shaped reversal candle after the release, 1:3
strategies.rules: 5m/15m: skip the release spike, enter on a reversal candle (hammer) against the first move / tight stop beyond the recent low (high) / target 1:3

strategies.name: Stochastic Hash 16/7/3 cross at 25/70, 3.18R
strategies.rules: 4H+: slow stoch 16/7/3, long when K crosses up D below 25, short when K crosses down D above 70 / stop 2.2% (ours: 1.2 ATR) / target 7% (3.18R), exit at the opposite extreme

strategies.name: Cowabunga: 4H trend + 15m EMA5/10, RSI9, stoch, MACD, 1R, out 16:00 NY
strategies.rules: 15m with 4H trend: EMA5 crosses EMA10, RSI9>50, stoch(10,3,3) rising not overbought, MACD hist turning up (short mirror) / stop at recent swing low / target round number or same pips as risk (ours 1R), close at 16:00 ET

strategies.name: EMA 5/13 cross + VWAP + ADX>20, stop at the cross, 2R
strategies.rules: 15m: EMA5 crosses EMA13, long above VWAP / short below, ADX>20 / stop at the EMA intersection / target RR 2

strategies.name: Pivot liquidity sweep + momentum candle + EMA200, 1:2
strategies.rules: 15m XAUUSD: break below last pivot low then close back above, momentum candle, above EMA200 (short mirror) / stop slightly beyond the pivot + ATR buffer / target 1:2

strategies.name: Toto SBL: EMA 50/100/200 aligned, swing sweep in killzones, 2R
strategies.rules: 15m London/NY killzones: EMA 50/100/200 aligned, sell-side liquidity sweep then a confirming up close (short mirror) / stop at the sweep level / target 2R

strategies.name: NY first 5m candle break, 1m FVG retest + engulfing, 3R
strategies.rules: 1m: break of the 9:30 ET first 5m candle high with an FVG, price digs into the FVG, engulfing close above the retest body (short mirror) / stop one tick below the dig candles / target 3:1

strategies.name: CPI anchored-VWAP retest after the spike, confirmation candle, 1:2
strategies.rules: CPI, 5m/15m: AVWAP anchored at the release candle, wait 5-10 min, after the spike enter on a pin bar/engulfing at the AVWAP retest against the spike / stop just beyond the spike extreme / target 1:1.5-1:2 (ours 1:2)

strategies.name: Doji sandwich continuation, stop at the doji, stochastic exit
strategies.rules: 4H: large candle, doji, large candle same direction -> enter at the 4th candle open / stop beyond the doji / exit when stochastic overbought (oversold for shorts)

strategies.name: VWAP cross + MACD flip, exit on the MACD cross back, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m: close through VWAP with MACD(12,26,9) crossing its signal the same way within 4-5 candles / stop beyond the recent swing / take profit when MACD crosses back

strategies.name: ALMA 21 + Stochastic 21/1/3 cross of 20/80, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m: close above ALMA(21,0.85,6) with stoch(21,1,3) crossing above 20 (short: below ALMA, cross below 80) / stop beyond nearest swing / take profit at the opposite stochastic zone

strategies.name: RSI(4) 80/20 + Bollinger touch, target the opposite band, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m: RSI(4) back above 20 with price at/through the lower BB(20,2) (short mirror at 80/upper) / stop beyond swing or outside the band / target the opposite band or RSI opposite zone

strategies.name: freqtrade ScalpingSimple: RSI<30 over SMA5, 0.5% stop, 1% target
strategies.rules: 1m long: RSI14<30, close>SMA5, up bar / stoploss -0.5% / ROI 1% (falling to 0.1% by 30 min), exit RSI>70 or SMA5 under SMA10

strategies.name: freqtrade MeanReversionScalper: BB + RSI + volume spike, out at mid band
strategies.rules: 5m long: close<=BB(20,2) lower, RSI14<30, volume>1.5x avg, BB width>0.5%, 1h EMA50 not falling >0.3% / stoploss -0.8% / ROI 0.6%, exit at the middle band

strategies.name: freqtrade RSI_BB: 1-SD lower band long, 3-SD upper band short
strategies.rules: 15m futures: long close<BB(20,1SD) lower; short RSI>56 and close>BB(20,3SD) upper; each exits on the other's signal / stoploss -10% / ROI 85%

strategies.name: DAX false breakout of the 20-bar low + SuperTrend 18/1.5, long
strategies.rules: 15m DAX long: previous bar a new 20-bar low, high under prior 20-bar high, up close, bar range < half the 20-bar range, close above SuperTrend(1.5,18) / stop 80 points (ours 4.5 ATR) / target 150 points (ours 8.4 ATR)

strategies.name: Jump: 16-bar mid +/- 2 ATR stop entry with 60m/30m filters, 5-minute
strategies.rules: 5m NASDAQ: buy stop at mid(16-bar high/low)+2ATR15 if close>close[24], 60m close>SMA300, 30m ADX>=20, not Friday (short mirror, ADX<=20, not Tuesday, low volatility) / stop 8 ATR20 / target 7 ATR20
